notes.note: Absence of a new snapshot is not deterministically observable; the test repeats 100 alt evaluations where the altstep's T1.timeout could only match if a fresh snapshot were taken after the preceding T1.timeout alternative failed. A correct tool always passes; a wrong one fails only probabilistically.

Tested as reject: a test case without runs on clause references a component variable, which does not exist for its MTC. Titan rejects test cases without runs on clause syntactically, so its rejection is not evidence of the checked rule.
Titan warning is wrong: Titan requires a runs on clause for test cases, but ConfigSpec ::= [RunsOnSpec] [SystemSpec] makes it optional in V4.17.1.

Ambiguous: chose the runtime-error reading (creating a PTC in a test case without system clause causes an error verdict), because the rule refers to what happens during test execution and PTC creation is not statically decidable in general.

Tested as reject: mapping to system:p in a test case without runs on and system clauses, where the TSI has no ports (a null component variable supplies the other end). Titan rejects test cases without runs on clause syntactically, so its rejection is not evidence of the checked rule.
Maps mtc:p to system:p without a system clause; execution requires a tool/adapter that supports mapping without an SUT.
